name: Chiraharit Ltd
about: Chiraharit is engaged into turnkey EPC (Engineering, Procurement and Construction) projects focusing on two broad segment viz Water-based and Renewable Energy-based. In the Water sector, our focus is on the efficient and reliable movement of piped water in pressurized applications.
keyPoints:
Business Profile[1]
The company is part of the Malaxmi Group, which operates across verticals such as water management, alternative fuels, property development, and infrastructure. It functions under the CHIRAMAX brand, with a strong focus on water-based projects and renewable energy initiatives.

pros: Company has a good return on equity (ROE) track record: 3 Years ROE 60.6%
cons: Company might be capitalizing the interest cost
